newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco plans new rules for retail credit.
newsitem.headline: Morocco plans new rules for retail credit.

text.p: Morocco's finance ministry and the central bank plan new rules to curb abuses in the retail credit market following complaints from MPs and the press, a finance ministry official said on Thursday.
The rules will lay out a model credit agreement for use by credit firms and retailers and will forbid the doorstep selling of retail credit.
The measures are aimed at greater transparency and better protection of consumers.
The ministry also plans to set up a network of credit firms, represented by agencies and offices. Credit firms and retailers have been operating without the advice of the monetary authorities.
